scope: Local Apple M2 production-build verification with Playwright 1.63.0. Real models run on the Mac, with no remote inference. Browser engine coverage does not establish compatibility with every device.

cache.name: pocket-composer-models-v1
cache.session_fallback: Bounded memory for files up to 32 MiB, 96 MiB total
cache.keys: Original URLs with immutable model revision; runtime URLs include the locked build revision.
cache.legacy_cache: Existing pinned Transformers.js files reused in place.

ordinary_production_suite.scope: 16 cache cases and 6 existing studio cases; real downloads explicitly opted in separately.

verified: Reuse in new workers, after reload and after normal browser restart
IndexedDB fallback when Cache Storage is unavailable
Legacy Transformers.js cache reuse without duplication
Generation bytes remain usable when storage is full or blocked
Aborted partial downloads are never cache hits
Primed page storage remains usable by workers in an ephemeral WebKit session

real_portable_melody_inference.profile: Normal persistent browser profiles, mobile viewport; WebKit mobile/touch mode

limitations: Physical iPhone Safari was not tested; WebKit engine and mobile layout were tested on the Mac.
The real optional large title-model reload check ran in Chromium; the storage regression and real melody/runtime checks ran in all three engines.
Private browsing, full storage, clearing website data and browser eviction can require downloads again. A storage warning is shown when persistence fails.
The site shell still requires network access after reload; this is model-file caching rather than a fully offline website.
